source.prompt: Instrumental background music for a classic 1990s-style Japanese fantasy role-playing game. The writing and orchestration evoke the golden age of 16-bit console RPG soundtracks (memorable singable lead melody, clear bass line, warm chords, tasteful hall reverb), but the production is high quality, warm and full, recorded with real-sounding instruments. Completely original melody. The game's world lives in an endless night lit by lanterns, lamps and great beacon fires; the score is gentle and melancholic, with warmth and a quiet, stubborn hope. Warm coral islands at night: lantern-lit harbours, fishermen's boats rocking on calm water, a boat song still sung for a captain who never came home. Breezy, swaying and nostalgic, sunny warmth under the stars with a touch of longing; a singable boat-song melody, relaxed but not sleepy. Tempo 96 BPM, 4/4 time, key of F major. Instrumentation: nylon-string guitar, marimba, flute melody, soft accordion, shaker and congas, upright bass, gentle steel-string guitar strums. Form: guitar and marimba pickup; section A flute boat-song melody; section B accordion melody, a little wistful; a short marimba interlude; section A again with fuller band. Duration: 110 seconds. Instrumental only: no vocals, no singing, no spoken words, no lyrics. Keep one steady tempo and key from start to finish, no fade-in and no fade-out, no long silences; the last bar leads naturally back into the first bar so the piece loops seamlessly as game background music.
